route3_transition.verdict: DECODED — Patrol::EnemyFound delegates to DefaultEnemyFoundResponse, which calls ControllerAI::SetState with the literal 'Pursue'. The Patrol -> Pursue handoff is REAL and unconditional once an enemy is found.
route3_transition.why_no_table: state transitions are dispatched by STRING name through ControllerAI::SetState, so there is no transition table to export. UNREACHED-T3 was looking for a structure that does not exist.

route2_sight_scan.note: the radius is a FLOAT MEMBER of the controller, read fresh on every scan; it is not an immediate, so no constant is decodable from this site alone

route4_UNREACHED_T5.verdict: DECODED. The accessors Lap T decoded read this+0x3dc / this+0x3e0; the WRITER is PatrolPoint::Load, which pulls two NAMED record fields, `radius` and `shouldRun`. On records/controllers/controlobjects/patrolpoint_01.dbr — the record every arena's patrol points instantiate — radius = 2.0 and shouldRun = True. UNREACHED-T5 is CLOSED.

route5_sight_radius.verdict: DECODED. FindEnemiesInSight queries with controller+0x21c, which ControllerAI::Load fills from the record field 'ViewDistance' (engine default 15.0 m). Every rolled tier-16 monster carries 80.0.
